text:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: high error-rate and latency cliffs on prefix cache + continuous-batching. Symptoms: sudden spike in unique cache keys, sustained cache-miss -> direct model invocations, model queue length rising. Paging eng-oncall. Incident ID INC-20260315-42.

sara: Taking the page — jumping into triage now.

devon: Seeing a cardinality explosion in metric prefix_cache.unique_keys (~8x). Correlates with a deploy at 2026-03-15T01:10Z that touched prompt templates.

alex: Logs show a huge number of cache-miss -> model calls. Tail latency climbed from ~120ms to ~420ms around the same time. Continuous batching queues spiked.

julia: Support: two customers (acme-pay, ledgerly) reporting 5xxs and timeouts. I'm opening tickets and pinging CS.

sara: Initial hypothesis: prompt normalization/tokenizer change caused hashing divergence so different prompt variants bypass prefix cache -> huge key space.

alex: Quick evidence: sample of recent prompts contains non-breaking space (U+00A0) in the template, tokenizer v2 treats it differently -> different token ids -> different hash.

sara: Immediate mitigations I'm going to apply: 1) disable prefix caching for affected model-family, 2) tighten batching config to reduce stress. Applying now.

sara: ```bash
# disable prefix cache for model family (hotfix)
redwoodctl feature set prefix_cache_enabled false --model-family rwd-open-7b
# reduce max batch size and shorten timeout to keep latency stable
redwoodctl routing update --pool inference-prod --max_batch_size 2 --batch_timeout_ms 50
```

oncall-bot: Automated monitor: after flag flip and batching change, cache key cardinality trending down, model QPS reduced, tail latency dropped to ~130ms within 2m.

devon: Root cause summary: hashing pipeline did sha1(tokenizer.encode(prompt)), but tokenizer v2 changed tokenization for NBSP/nonstandard spaces. We need to canonicalize templates before tokenization.

alex: Minimal patch idea: normalize Unicode and replace non-breaking/zero-width spaces before tokenizing. Example:```python
import unicodedata
def normalize_prompt(s):
    return unicodedata.normalize("NFC", s).replace("\u00A0", " ").replace("\u200B", "")
# then compute hash over tokenizer.encode(normalize_prompt(s))
```

sara: I'm going to open a small PR with that hotfix and run synthetic tests against the canonical prompt set. Will canary the change behind a feature flag.

mike: I'll be on-call handoff in 30m. Please add a concise handoff note with current status and next steps.

sara: Handoff summary for @mike: mitigations applied (prefix cache disabled for rwd-open-7b, batching limited to max_batch_size=2). Customer impact: ~12k requests affected in the window, acme-pay and ledgerly saw ~10-15% errors during peak; tail latency SLO breached for ~4 minutes. Root cause: prompt normalization/tokenizer mismatch introduced a drift in hash keys. Next steps: patch hashing code (normalize prompts), run synthetic test suite, canary deploy in staging and prod, then re-enable prefix cache gradually.

support-bot: Created tickets: SUP-9342 (acme-pay), SUP-9343 (ledgerly). CS notified and shared mitigation steps.

julia: I'll run a quick scan across prompt templates to detect NBSP/ZWSP occurrences and list affected templates. Running: `git grep -n --perl-regexp "\\x{00A0}|\\x{200B}" -- templates/`

devon: Running a sweep on historical prompts as well; will produce a short list of template ids to normalize.

sara: Going to cut the PR now. I'll coordinate canary + smoke tests. Monitoring in watch.

oncall-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Time to mitigate ~6m. Keeping thread open for postmortem and handoff.

mike: Copy — I'm taking over. Immediate action items I've picked up: 1) validate the PR smoke on staging, 2) run chaos/synthetic prompt set against affected model family, 3) prepare rollback plan in case re-enable causes spike.

sara: Thanks. I'll add the incident doc and postmortem checklist to the incident tracker. Please include links to the template-normalization PR and the customer support tickets.

julia: Quick note: we should add a pre-deploy lint in CI to fail on NBSP/ZWSP in templates to avoid future drift.

devon: Agree — adding normalization + CI check to the prompt pipeline. Also we'll add a canary metric for cache key cardinality to alert earlier.

sara: Final: incident state -> monitoring, mitigation in prod. Root cause identified, hotfix PR open, handoff to @mike for deploy/canary. Will follow up with postmortem once fully resolved.
